newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank retracts FP Bank licence.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank retracts FP Bank licence.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) has decided to retract the licence of First Private Bank (FPB), in receivership since May 17 last year, a central bank official said on Thursday.
"The BNB board decided to retract the licence of First Private Bank for failing to comply with banking regulations," the official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
The official declined to name the reasons for the decision but said a BNB statement could be expected later in the day.
FPB can appeal against the decision, the official said.
The central bank put FPB, Bulgaria's biggest private bank, in receivership, citing a danger of insolvency, dismissed its management and appointed sequestrators to establish its financial state.
The bank was banned from extending credits, servicing payments and dealing in government securities.
On May 31, 1996 the BNB initiated a bankruptcy procedure through the courts against against FPB
At the end of last year the Sofia City Court ruled against the BNB insolvency claim, saying it was not supported by enough evidence. -- Sofia Newsroom, 3592 911 88
